methods.method_description: Click on Add icon button on Printers screen
methods.method_purpose: Clicks on Add icon button on Printers screen. Tries primary add button, falls back to alternative if not found. End of flow: Add Printer screen or Popup display for clicking this button first time.

methods.method_description: Click on Allow button of Looking for Wi-Fi printers? button

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Flag to determine if location permission dialog should be handled

methods.method_purpose: Clicks on Looking for Wi-Fi Direct printers button and optionally handles location permission dialog. End of flow: Printer screen with App Permission display if clicked at first time.

methods.method_description: Click on Search icon button in Printers page (WiFi-Direct/network printer)
methods.method_purpose: Clicks on Search icon button in Printers page and waits for printer title to become invisible. End of flow: Search screen.

methods.method_description: Enter key_word to text field and press enter on virtual key

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Search keyword to enter in the search text field

methods.method_purpose: Enters a keyword into the search text field to search for printers. End of flow: found printer list or empty list.
